pairs.subject: metric-gates
pairs.evidence: scripts/lint/ts-ratchet.mjs:142 Suppression baselines retain per-rule totals without item identities, allowing different suppressed code to replace an existing occurrence while the gate remains green.

techniques.evidence: scripts/lint/ts-ratchet.mjs:191 The tree counter aggregates rule counts without retaining file or suppression identities; a read-only probe confirmed that different suppressed operations produce identical counts and passing verdicts.

scripts/perf/check-budget.mjs:516 The static graph substitutes deterministic module and source-byte counts for compilation cost, but its default 15% headroom is justified as allowing ordinary growth rather than derived from measured counter repeat variance.

eslint.config.mjs:155 The cost rule has an AST selector, scopes and repair guidance, but its known-bad fixtures have no consuming runner; tracked-code searches found only their declarations, while the coverage tests inspect configured messages rather than exercise this selector.

scripts/lint/ts-ratchet.mjs:133 Appending a bare '--' clears the unreasoned classification without supplying an explanation; the instrument neither separately counts these empty satisfiers nor distinguishes them from substantive reasons.

scripts/perf/check-budget.mjs:364 The suppression ratchets correctly report drops, but the graph-budget gate reports only ceiling breaches and missing inputs; below-ceiling shrinkage produces no actionable drop finding, and the CI test accepts the empty findings array.
